units.source_text: 丰后介叫道：“三条在哪里？

en.t: Bungo no Suke called out, "Where is Sanjo?

units.source_text: 小姐叫你呢。”

en.t: The young lady is calling for you."

units.source_text: 三条便走过来。

en.t: Sanjo then came over.

units.source_text: 右近一看，又是个相识的人。

en.t: When Ukon looked, she saw that this too was someone she knew.

units.source_text: 她认得这人是已故的夕颜夫人的侍女，曾经多年伺候夫人。

en.t: She recognized the woman as a maid of the late Lady Yugao, one who had served her for many years.

units.source_text: 夫人隐居在五条地方的租屋内时，此人也曾来供职。

en.t: When the lady was living in seclusion in a rented house in the Gojo district, this woman had also come to serve there.

units.source_text: 现在看到她，觉得仿佛是在梦中。

en.t: Seeing her now, Ukon felt as though she were in a dream.

units.source_text: 右近很想见见她现在的主人，可是没有办法。

en.t: Ukon very much wanted to meet her present mistress, but there was no way to do so.

units.source_text: 左思右想：还是向这三条探问。

en.t: After turning it over in her mind, she decided she had better ask this Sanjo.

units.source_text: 刚才看见的男子，恐怕就是从前的兵藤太。

en.t: The man she had just seen was probably the Hyodota of long ago.

units.source_text: 也许玉鬘小姐也在这里。

en.t: Perhaps Lady Tamakazura was here as well.

units.source_text: 她想到这里，心中焦灼难忍。

en.t: When this thought came to her, her heart burned with unbearable impatience.

units.source_text: 她知道三条住在隔壁房中的帐幕旁边，便派人去邀请她。

en.t: Knowing that Sanjo was staying beside the curtain in the next room, she sent someone to invite her over.

units.source_text: 但三条正在吃饭，一时不能过来。

en.t: But Sanjo was eating and could not come at once.

units.source_text: 右近等得厌烦，心中非常懊恼，这也未免太任性了。

en.t: Ukon grew tired of waiting and felt terribly vexed, thinking this was really much too willful.

units.source_text: 过了一会，三条好容易来了。

en.t: After a while, Sanjo finally came.

units.source_text: 她一面走进来，一面嘴里说着：“这倒是意想不到的了。

en.t: As she came in, she was saying, "Well, this is quite unexpected.

units.source_text: 我在筑紫住了二十来年，只当一个侍女，京中怎么会有人认识我呢？

en.t: I have lived in Tsukushi for more than twenty years, only as a maid, so how could anyone in the capital know me?

units.source_text: 想是看错了吧？”

en.t: Surely they must have mistaken me for someone else?"

units.source_text: 三条作乡下人打扮，身穿一件小袖绸袄，上罩一件大红绢衫，身体很肥胖。

en.t: Sanjo was dressed like a country woman, wearing a small-sleeved silk padded jacket with a bright red silk robe over it, and she had grown very stout.

units.source_text: 右近看见她已长得这么大，想起自己也已老了，不免心中怅惘。

en.t: Seeing how much she had grown, Ukon thought that she herself had also grown old, and could not help feeling wistful.

units.source_text: 她把脸正对着三条，对她说道：“你仔细看看，认得我么？”

en.t: She turned her face directly toward Sanjo and said to her, "Look carefully. Do you recognize me?"

units.source_text: 三条向她一看，拍手叫道：“哎呀，原来是你！

en.t: Sanjo looked at her, clapped her hands, and cried, "Oh my, it is you!

units.source_text: 我真高兴，我高兴死了！

en.t: I am so glad, so glad I could die!

units.source_text: 你是从哪里来进香的？

en.t: From where have you come to make your pilgrimage?

units.source_text: 夫人也来了么？”

en.t: Has the lady come too?"

units.source_text: 说着，抽抽噎噎地哭起来。

en.t: As she spoke, she began to sob.

units.source_text: 右近记得和她共处时，她还是个少女。

en.t: Ukon remembered that when they had lived together, Sanjo had still been a young girl.

units.source_text: 回想当年情景，暗数流光，感慨无量。

en.t: Thinking back on those days and silently counting the years that had passed, she was filled with emotion.

units.source_text: 便回答道：“我先要问你：乳母老太太也来这里么？

en.t: Then she answered, "First I must ask you: has the old nurse come here too?

units.source_text: 小姐怎么样？

en.t: How is the young lady?

units.source_text: 贵君呢？”

en.t: And what of your master?"

units.source_text: 关于夕颜夫人之事，她想起了她临终时情况，觉得说出来叫人吃惊，不敢出口，终于不说。

en.t: As for Lady Yugao, Ukon remembered the circumstances of her death and felt that speaking of them would shock the others, so she could not bring herself to say anything and in the end kept silent.

units.source_text: 三条答道：“大家都在这里。

en.t: Sanjo replied, "Everyone is here.

units.source_text: 小姐已长大成人了。

en.t: The young lady has grown into an adult.

units.source_text: 我先要去告诉老太太。”

en.t: I must go and tell the old lady first."

units.source_text: 便走进去了。

en.t: Then she went inside.
